title: First Steps on Ice
context: Lena 在室内冰场初学滑冰，朋友 Max 陪她慢慢练习。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，内容和练习题均为原创，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: These skates feel strange. Is it normal to wobble this much?
dialogue.zh: 穿着这双冰鞋感觉怪怪的。晃得这么厉害正常吗？

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: It was the same for me at first. Let's stay near the rail.
dialogue.zh: 我刚开始也一样。我们先待在扶手旁边吧。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: I can hold it while I get used to the ice.
dialogue.zh: 我可以扶着它，慢慢适应冰面。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: That's a good idea. Try bending your knees a little.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。试着稍微弯曲膝盖。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Like this? I feel a little more steady now.
dialogue.zh: 这样吗？我现在觉得稳一点了。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Yes. Take small steps, and don't worry about going fast.
dialogue.zh: 对。迈小步就好，别急着滑快。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Would you stay beside me when I let go?
dialogue.zh: 我松手的时候，你能待在我旁边吗？

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Of course. I'm right here if you need me.
dialogue.zh: 当然。需要我的话，我就在这儿。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: I made it to the blue line without holding on!
dialogue.zh: 我没扶着东西就滑到蓝线了！

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Nice work! Do you want to take a break on the bench?
dialogue.zh: 做得好！想去长椅上休息一下吗？

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Yes, my feet could use a rest. Then I'd like to try again.
dialogue.zh: 想，我的脚需要休息一下。然后我还想再试试。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Sounds good. You've already made a great start.
dialogue.zh: 好啊。你已经有了很好的开始。

expressions.example: It took me a week to get used to my new shoes.
Hold on to the rail as you go down the steps.
She let go of the rope when she reached the ground.
Let's take a break after this page.
We made a start on the puzzle yesterday.

pronunciation: skates 的末尾 /ts/ 要两个辅音都发出来；steady 重读第一个音节，后面的音节轻短。

practice.title: Part 1 · Learning a sport
practice.prompt: Have you ever tried a new sport?
practice.answer: Yes. I tried skating with a friend last winter. At first I was nervous, but I enjoyed learning a little at a time.

practice.title: Part 2 · A new physical activity
practice.prompt: Describe a physical activity you tried for the first time. Say where you tried it, who helped you, and how you felt.
practice.answer: Last winter I tried ice skating at an indoor rink with my friend. I felt unsteady when I first stepped onto the ice, so I stayed close to the rail. My friend showed me how to bend my knees and take small steps. After a short break, I tried again and reached a line without holding on. I was tired but proud, and I wanted to come back. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Learning and confidence
practice.prompt: How can beginners become more confident when learning a sport?
practice.answer: A patient teacher and a comfortable place to practice can help. Small goals let beginners see their progress, and taking breaks can make the experience more enjoyable.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读对话，再向朋友描述你初学一项运动时的感受，并请求陪伴。
practice.answer: I feel a little unsteady on these skates. Could you stay beside me? I want to take a few small steps.
